premises.text: Organizers and members currently must use multiple separate platforms to run and engage a community
premises.evidence_span: I've had to use five platforms to stay organized

premises.text: A single umbrella platform can provide communication, event, member, and transaction management for organizers
premises.evidence_span: Communication management, event management, member management, transaction management, under one umbrella

premises.text: Hierarchical chapters and multi-tier subgroups can be managed online with local autonomy and global control
premises.evidence_span: Each group can have as many subgroups as they want and as many tiers of subgroups as they need

premises.text: Interest-topic channels curate groups and events so users can discover relevant communities
premises.evidence_span: Channels are a curated list of groups for a given interest topic

premises.text: Most groups are free; revenue comes from channel subscriptions, premium groups, and transaction service fees
premises.evidence_span: for the vast majority of groups, it's entirely free

premises.text: The platform serves any community type, not only entrepreneurship groups
premises.evidence_span: Cohort is for any type of community

value.text: Organizers get a single solution to engage membership and connect community
value.evidence_span: the single solution that an organizer needs to engage their membership

secondary_value.text: Unify and export entrepreneurship communities globally
secondary_value.evidence_span: unify the entire entrepreneurial ecosystem and export entrepreneurship globally

causal_links.evidence_span: managing those organizations has been incredibly challenging
for the vast majority of groups, it's entirely free

notes: Pain-list of five platforms folded as one problem-set (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Communication/event/member/transaction listed as one umbrella mechanism, not four premises. Channels framed as a new discovery module and kept separate. Singleton D1 and D3 retained as independently revisable problem diagnosis and monetization. Traction (10k signups, named orgs, raise) excluded per §4.2.
